Cyprus recorded a sharp rise between 2020 and 2021 (from 80.3 to 104.6), peaking in 2023 (109.9), before falling to 94.7 in 2025.

Lithuania improved from 73.8 in 2018 to 94.7 in 2024, with a small decline to 91.2 in 2025.

Czechia increased from 74.4 in 2018 to 99.1 by 2023-2024, followed by a drop to 90.8 in 2025.

Greece experienced consistent growth between 2018 (70.0) and 2024 (88.2), with a slight dip to 85.3 in 2025.

Croatia steadily improved its score from 61.2 in 2018 to a high of 81.6 in 2024, followed by a slight decline in 2025 (reaching 80.6).

Emerging Innovators
